policy: Every observed event remains visible. Raw action IDs are authoritative. Unique current-build recount joins form explicit parent-child rows; all other nonlocalized identities retain their exact design, actor, monster, and action-kind evidence as build-scoped technical names instead of guessed player skills.
runtime_policy: The BPSR plug-in resolves packet identity and ownership into compact sorted lookup tables. Combat History renders the canonical hierarchy without replaying packets. Future rDPS attribution remains a separate consumer and may not rename, hide, or discard source events.
